metadata.domain: Autonomous Driving Platform / ADAS / Automotive Electronics

evidence.trl_pathway: T01 (TRL 6→completion in 2 years) and T03 (TRL 7) are reasonable, but T03's planned duration of 0 quarters (2030-Q1 to 2030-Q1) is highly unrealistic — a TRL 7 process technology cannot be developed instantaneously, suggesting a planning error or dependency bottleneck collapse.
evidence.strategic_fidelity: The portfolio includes mid-to-high TRL technologies (TRL 5–7) with limited exploratory R&D depth, which is more characteristic of market-following than true technology leadership; however, the longer development timelines and dependency chains show some 기술선도 intent.
evidence.competitive_awareness: All three technologies — sensor fusion cameras, 3D pose estimation, and steer-by-wire — are squarely within the autonomous driving/ADAS domain, demonstrating solid domain fit and awareness of core competitive battlegrounds in automotive electronics.
evidence.market_timing: Two of three technologies (T08 and T03) complete more than 2 years after their respective market boom windows (errors of 2.25yr and 2.0yr), and even for 기술선도 strategy the preemption window is missed; only T01 has a marginally acceptable timing offset of 0.75 years post-boom.
evidence.patent_market_convergence: The selected technologies are in active patent and market growth areas for ADAS, but there is no explicit evidence in the roadmap that convergence-zone analysis drove the selection — the choices appear domain-appropriate but not demonstrably convergence-optimized.

strengths: All selected technologies are firmly within the autonomous driving/ADAS domain, ensuring competitive relevance and institutional knowledge leverage.
Dependency chain (T01→T08→T03) is logically structured and has zero violations, reflecting coherent systems thinking.
weaknesses: Severe market timing lag: two of three technologies complete 2+ years after their boom windows, undermining both commercial value and technology leadership positioning.
T03 (스테어 바이 와이어 제어) has a zero-duration development window (2030-Q1 to 2030-Q1), which is technically implausible and suggests a cascading scheduling failure from upstream delays.
missing_technologies: LiDAR-based perception or solid-state LiDAR (lower TRL, higher exploratory value for 기술선도)
V2X / Vehicle-to-Everything communication platform (critical for multi-agent autonomous driving ecosystem)
AI-based end-to-end driving policy network (core R&D differentiator for technology leadership)
investment_issues: Budget is fully exhausted (100% utilization) with only 3 technologies, leaving no reserve for risk mitigation or opportunistic investments in emerging 기술선도 candidates.
T03 is classified as 'High' tier despite being the terminal dependency in the chain — if upstream technologies are delayed, this investment yields zero return within the reference horizon.
The portfolio lacks any Tier=Exploratory investments, which is inconsistent with a 기술선도 strategic direction that should reserve budget for early-stage, high-upside R&D.
timing_issues: T08 (3D 포즈 추정 시스템) completes in 2030-Q1 but market boom is 2027-Q4 — a 2.25-year post-boom delivery that misses peak adoption entirely.
T03 (스테어 바이 와이어 제어) has a zero-length development window due to dependency bottleneck, making its 2030-Q1 completion both unrealistic and 2 years late relative to the 2028-Q1 boom.
The cascade of T01 delays propagates through the entire dependency chain, amplifying timing errors downstream.
